name: Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, Nigam provides loans of up to ₹20,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate to individuals from minority communities to enhance their employability.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 55 years.
   1. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹98,000/- (Rural Area) and ₹1,20,000/- (Urban Area).
   1. The applicant should belong to a minority community, i.e., Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains.
   1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
